devdoc.details: Registry for trusted claim issuers in the ERC-3643 token system

addTrustedIssuer(address,uint256[]).details: Adds a trusted issuer with their claim topics

params.claimTopics: Array of claim topics the issuer can issue

getTrustedIssuerClaimTopics(address).details: Gets the claim topics a trusted issuer can issue

getTrustedIssuers().details: Gets the list of all trusted issuers

getTrustedIssuersCount().details: Gets the number of trusted issuers

isTrustedIssuer(address).details: Checks if an address is a trusted issuer

returns._0: True if the address is a trusted issuer

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions anymore. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby removing any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

updateIssuerClaimTopics(address,uint256[.details: Updates the claim topics of a trusted issuer
